This Privacy Policy describes how the CHSHUB Owner mobile application collects, uses, stores, and protects information. Use the switch above to view the section of this policy specific to CHSHUB Gatekeeper instead.

This app is owned and operated by Vengurla Tech ("we", "us", or "our").

01

Information we collect

🔑

Account & profile information

  • Mobile number, used for OTP-based login
  • Name, email address, date of birth, and gender (optional)
  • Society, building, wing, and flat/unit details
  • Profile photo, optionally captured or uploaded by you
  • Uploaded ownership or identity documents
🚗

Vehicle & household information

  • Vehicle number, model, and type, and parking allotment
  • Domestic staff / helper records added by you
👥

Visitor information

When you approve or manage a visitor, delivery, cab, or service person at the gate, the app records:

  • Visitor's name and phone number
  • Purpose of visit and company name, for service or delivery visitors
  • Vehicle number, if applicable
  • Visitor's photograph, captured at entry by security staff
  • Entry and exit time, and your approval status
💳

Maintenance & payments

  • Maintenance bills, dues, and transaction history
  • Payment records processed through our payment gateway, Razorpay

Device permissions

📷

Camera — to capture visitor, staff, and profile photographs

🖼️

Photos/Media — to select images from your device gallery

🔔

Notifications — to alert you about visitor entries and updates

🌐

Internet/Network access — to communicate with our servers

No GPS / location data is accessed or collected.

02

How we use your information

  • Verify your identity and manage your flat, household, and vehicle records
  • Let you approve or deny visitor, delivery, and service entries in real time
  • Display and process maintenance bills, dues, and payments
  • Send notifications about visitors, bills, complaints, polls, and society announcements
  • Enable society administrators to manage residents, facilities, and communication
  • Improve the security and functioning of the app
03

Data storage

All data, including profile and visitor photographs, is stored securely on our servers. Authentication is handled using secure tokens stored on your device; we do not store your password in plain text. We do not share, sell, or rent your personal data to third parties for marketing purposes.

04

Third-party services

Firebase Cloud Messaging (Google)

to deliver push notifications, such as visitor and bill alerts. No personal data beyond what is necessary for notification delivery is shared with this service.

Razorpay

to securely process maintenance and other payments. Payment details are handled directly by Razorpay under its own privacy policy; we do not store your card or bank details. Read their privacy policy at https://razorpay.com/privacy/.

We maintain data processing terms with each third-party service provider listed above, in line with their standard terms of service.

05

Information sharing

Residents in the same society can see limited profile information about each other — such as name, flat/unit, and contact details — in the society directory, and gatekeepers can see visitor details you submit for approval. We do not share your personal information with business partners, affiliates, or advertisers.

We do not display third-party advertisements in the app, and we do not sell or share your personal information for advertising purposes.

06

Data retention

Profile, visitor, and payment records are retained for as long as necessary to provide the service and to comply with the society's record-keeping requirements. You may request deletion of your account and associated data by contacting us.

07

Data security

We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. Access to resident and visitor data is restricted to authorized society administrators and staff only.

08

Children's privacy

The app is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

09

Your rights

  • Access, update, or correct your personal information by logging into your account settings, or by contacting us
  • Request deletion of your account and associated data
  • Withdraw consent for photo capture, subject to the app's core security functionality

We will respond to access, correction, or deletion requests as required under applicable privacy law.

10

Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected with an updated "Last updated" date at the top of this page.

11

Contact us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, or wish to exercise your rights over your personal information, please contact:

✉️ Vengurla Tech support@vengurlatech.com

This Privacy Policy describes how the CHSHUB Gatekeeper mobile application collects, uses, stores, and protects information. Use the switch above to view the section of this policy specific to CHSHUB Owner instead.

This app is owned and operated by Vengurla Tech ("we", "us", or "our").

01

Information we collect

🔑

Account & login information

  • Mobile number, used for OTP-based login
  • Staff name, ID, and photo
  • Society and gate/post assignment details
👥

Visitor information

When you register a visitor, delivery, cab, or service person at the gate, the app collects:

  • Visitor's name and phone number
  • Purpose of visit
  • Vehicle number, if applicable
  • Company name, for service or delivery visitors
  • Flat/unit being visited and address details
  • Visitor's photograph, captured at entry
  • Entry and exit time, and approval status
⏱️

Staff & attendance information

  • Staff name, ID, and photo
  • Check-in and check-out timestamps

Device permissions

📷

Camera — to capture visitor, staff, and profile photographs

🖼️

Photos/Media — to select images from your device gallery

🔔

Notifications — to alert you about visitor entries and updates

🌐

Internet/Network access — to communicate with our servers

No GPS / location data is accessed or collected.

02

How we use your information

  • Verify identity and manage entry/exit of visitors, staff, and vehicles
  • Send real-time notifications to residents and gatekeepers about visitor arrivals
  • Maintain attendance records for security staff
  • Enable society administrators to manage staff, gate posts, and security records
  • Improve the security and functioning of the app
03

Data storage

All data, including visitor and staff photographs, is stored securely on our servers. Authentication is handled using secure tokens stored on your device; we do not store your password in plain text. We do not share, sell, or rent your personal data to third parties for marketing purposes.

04

Third-party services

Firebase Cloud Messaging (Google)

used solely to deliver push notifications, such as visitor entry alerts. No personal data beyond what is necessary for notification delivery, such as visitor name and unit, is shared with this service.

We maintain data processing terms with each third-party service provider listed above, in line with their standard terms of service.

05

Information sharing

Gatekeepers can see visitor and resident details necessary to verify and approve entry at the gate. We do not share your personal information with business partners, affiliates, or advertisers.

We do not display third-party advertisements in the app, and we do not sell or share your personal information for advertising purposes.

06

Data retention

Visitor and attendance records are retained for as long as necessary to provide the service and to comply with the society's record-keeping and security requirements. Staff may request deletion of their account and associated data by contacting us.

07

Data security

We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. Access to visitor and resident data is restricted to authorized society administrators, gatekeepers, and staff only.

08

Children's privacy

The app is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

09

Your rights

  • Access, update, or correct your personal information by logging into your account settings, or by contacting us
  • Request deletion of your account and associated data
  • Withdraw consent for photo capture, subject to the app's core security functionality

We will respond to access, correction, or deletion requests as required under applicable privacy law.

10

Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected with an updated "Last updated" date at the top of this page.

11

Contact us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, or wish to exercise your rights over your personal information, please contact:

✉️ Vengurla Tech support@vengurlatech.com
